description: The plot illustrates an ablation study on the HateXplain dataset, representing variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants. The x-axis is labeled "Model Variants" and features a categorical scale with the following nominal categories from left to right: "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 58 to 66, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The "Precision" metric is represented by a solid purple line with circular markers. It begins at a value of 65.45 for the "Full model (Ours)", decreases to 61.06 for "w/o Prompt", and then steadily increases across the remaining categories, reaching 62.22 for "w/o Augmentation", 64.06 for "w/o Attention", and ending at 65.44 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The "Recall" metric is depicted by a solid blue line with circular markers. It starts at 65.78 for the "Full model (Ours)", drops to 59.64 for "w/o Prompt", rises to 63.75 for "w/o Augmentation", and then declines to 59.17 for "w/o Attention" before ending at its lowest point of 56.82 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". Finally, the "F1-score" is shown as a solid brown line with circular markers. It starts at 65.56 for the "Full model (Ours)", decreases to 60.16 for "w/o Prompt", rises to 62.63 for "w/o Augmentation", and then declines through 59.67 for "w/o Attention" to end at 57.74 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation".
caption_used: Ablation study on the HateXplain dataset. The line chart illustrates variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate. The x-axis represents the 'Model Variants', labeled as nominal categories: 'Full model (Ours)', 'w/o Prompt', 'w/o Augmentation', 'w/o Attention', and 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. The y-axis represents 'Metric (%)' with a linear scale, ranging from 58 to 66, marked at intervals of 2%. The purple line, representing 'Precision,' uses circles as markers and a solid line style. It starts at approximately 65.45% with the 'Full model (Ours)' and shows a consistent decline across the variants, reaching its lowest point at 57.74% for 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. The blue line signifies 'Recall,' featuring circles and a solid line. It begins at 65.78% for 'Ours', drops sharply to 59.64% with 'w/o Prompt,' and continues to decline steadily, reaching 56.82% at 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation.' The brown line illustrates the 'F1-score' using circles and a solid line, starting at 65.16%, decreasing to 60.16% for 'w/o Prompt', and showing a slight increase at 'w/o Augmentation' before dropping again to 57.74% with 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. There is a legend on the bottom left of the plot to infer the line color from their labels.
